research_question: Under the exact uniform null for exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number tickets with union18, how often does the unchanged target-1251 strict gate falsely pass over an 850-target evaluation?
novelty_vs_completed_work: E036 calibrated a different single-ticket/five-line null statistic and did not evaluate the target-1251 four-metric three-line gate.
E045 and E054 evaluated predictive portfolios against the exact union18 null but did not estimate the strict gate's false-pass rate under repeated null-only trajectories.
This study evaluates no predictive model and changes no gate threshold.

null_geometry.generation: For each target, uniformly sample an ordered 18-subset without replacement from 1..45, then partition consecutive groups of six into three lines. This is distributionally equivalent to applying a uniformly sampled label permutation to any fixed disjoint union18 three-line portfolio.
null_geometry.target_outcomes: Use the fixed observed main-number outcomes for targets 401..1250 only as conditional labels. No target outcome is used to select or rank a ticket.
null_geometry.exact_null_verification: Independently derive the four expectations from the hypergeometric distribution of the number of winning labels in a uniform 18-subset and the conditional multivariate-hypergeometric allocation across three six-slot lines; require absolute error <= 1e-12 versus the frozen E045 values.

strict_gate.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from exact null. Match E045: block sizes are consecutive 50-target blocks, sample each block independently with replacement, each sampled block start is uniform over every valid contiguous start; retain final remainder if present.
strict_gate.false_pass_definition: A null trajectory is a false pass only if all four adjusted moving-block CI lower bounds are strictly > 0 and at least 65% of its 17 non-overlapping 50-target any2-delta blocks are positive.
strict_gate.bootstrap_quantile_indices_rule: For 4000 sorted bootstrap means, lower index=floor((0.0125/2)*(4000-1))=24; upper index=floor((1-0.0125/2)*(4000-1))=3974, matching the frozen E045 percentile index rule.

simulation.rng: xorshift32; fixed seed and deterministic stream; partial Fisher-Yates sampling without replacement
simulation.bootstrap_seed_rule: For trajectory index r=0..999 and metric index m=0..3, use xorshift32 seed (base_seed + 1000003*r + 9000 + m) mod 2^32; this varies the bootstrap stream by null trajectory while retaining deterministic reproducibility.

reporting.primary_endpoint: Empirical joint strict-gate false-pass rate across 1000 null trajectories with 95% Wilson interval.
secondary_endpoints: Per-metric false-positive rate for each adjusted CI lower bound.
Distribution of any2 positive 50-target block share.
Empirical null means compared with exact analytic expectations.
reporting.promotion_effect: None. This study cannot create STRICT_PASS_READY or authorize purchase lines.
